verdict.rationale: React is a library whose product surface is its documented public JavaScript API. The evidence shows first-party reference docs for entry points such as createRoot and hydrateRoot, including documented options like onUncaughtError and identifierPrefix, plus the 'use client' directive and official TypeScript types. A machine-readable llms.txt also helps AI-native consumers; the missing OpenAPI spec is irrelevant because React is not an HTTP service. Missing for 10: evidence covering the broader API reference (hooks, react-dom/server), and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic use beyond one community note on custom renderer interfaces.
